title: B197 — Alert on failing DataHub ingestion runs
description:
## Why

Two DataHub managed-ingestion sources failed **every day for 10+ days** and nothing alerted (found 2026-09-27 during B194): `dbt - Weyland` (undecryptable UI secrets → `NoCredentialsError`, then a masked `entity:primary` connector bug) and `MLFlow - Weyland` (MLflow 3's demo experiment crashed the connector). dbt model docs, tests and column lineage silently stopped reaching the catalog. Both are fixed, but the class is open: a failing ingestion is invisible until someone happens to look. The `ts_datahub_ingestion` Dagster asset already copies ingestion run history into TimescaleDB (`datahub_ingestion_runs`), and nothing alerts on it. The DataHub coverage guard stayed green throughout, because the Iceberg source catalogs the same tables.

## Scope

1. A per-source ingestion watchdog on the existing pattern (like `dagster-freshness-check`): for each ingestion source, alert when the **latest run FAILED** (`DataHubIngestionFailed`) or when there is **no SUCCESS within \~2× its schedule** (`DataHubIngestionStale`), posted to Alertmanager → Telegram.
2. Source the data from the DataHub GraphQL `listIngestionSources { executions }` (authoritative) — or from `datahub_ingestion_runs` if that table is reliably fresh; choose one and state why.
3. A freshness rule + `schedules.md` row for the watchdog itself; runbook section in `docs/runbooks/datahub.md`.
4. An alert drill (force a stale budget in a one-off Job, as B194 did) proving the alert reaches Telegram.

## Technical context

| Where | What | Role |
| -- | -- | -- |
| mother | DataHub GMS GraphQL (`listIngestionSources`, `executions`) | source of run status |
| mother | `k8s/monitoring/` (new CronJob) or `k8s/dagster/` | the watchdog |
| mother | Alertmanager (`monitoring-kube-prometheus-alertmanager`) | routing to Telegram |
| repo | `k8s/monitoring/cron-freshness-rules.yaml`, `docs/schedules.md`, `docs/runbooks/datahub.md` | freshness + docs |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A source whose latest run FAILED fires `DataHubIngestionFailed` naming the source (proven by a bats/fixture test and one live drill).
- [ ] A source with no SUCCESS inside its budget fires `DataHubIngestionStale`.
- [ ] GMS unreachable or an empty source list is exit 2 (could-not-run), never a clean pass.
- [ ] The watchdog itself has a freshness rule and a schedules.md row.

## Edge cases & failure modes

* A source that has never run (new) must alert, not be silently skipped (the B196 never-ran class).
* Sources that run on demand only (e.g. `[CLI] dbt`) are listed as accepted exceptions with the reason.
* A run stuck RUNNING forever (orphaned by an actions-pod restart, seen 2026-09-27) must count as not-succeeded.

## Out of scope

* Fixing individual connectors (done in B194's close-out).
* Replacing DataHub managed ingestion.

Relates B194 (found there), B196 (the Dagster watchdog guard), B158 (DataHub coverage guard). Detail: [https://github.com/edtbl76/weyland-lab/blob/main/docs/backlog.md](<https://github.com/edtbl76/weyland-lab/blob/main/docs/backlog.md>)
